s4_attain_by_region:
SELECT hb.region AS sales_region, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment
FROM opportunities o
JOIN hr_bridge hb ON o.employee_id = hb.employee_id
GROUP BY hb.region
ORDER BY hb.region;
s4_revenue_by_region:
SELECT hb.region AS sales_region, SUM(o.closed_revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM opportunities o
JOIN hr_bridge hb ON o.employee_id = hb.employee_id
GROUP BY hb.region
ORDER BY hb.region;
s4_attain_advneg:
WITH learner_rep AS (
  SELECT l.learner_id, hb.employee_id
  FROM learners l
  JOIN hr_bridge hb ON lower(replace(l.email, '.contractor', '')) = lower(hb.work_email)
),
rep_course_flags AS (
  SELECT lr.employee_id,
    COALESCE(BOOL_OR(c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation'), FALSE) AS completed_advneg,
    COALESCE(BOOL_OR(c.course_name = 'Intro to Spreadsheets'), FALSE) AS completed_distract
  FROM learner_rep lr
  LEFT JOIN course_completions cc ON cc.learner_id = lr.learner_id
  LEFT JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = cc.course_id
  GROUP BY lr.employee_id
)
SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment
FROM opportunities o
JOIN rep_course_flags rcf ON o.employee_id = rcf.employee_id
WHERE rcf.completed_advneg = TRUE;

s4_assess_emea:
WITH learner_rep AS (
  SELECT l.learner_id, hb.employee_id, hb.region
  FROM learners l
  JOIN hr_bridge hb ON lower(replace(l.email, '.contractor', '')) = lower(hb.work_email)
)
SELECT AVG(a.score) AS avg_assessment_score
FROM assessment_scores a
JOIN learner_rep lr ON a.learner_id = lr.learner_id
WHERE lr.region = 'EMEA';

s5_advneg_lift:
WITH learner_rep AS (
  SELECT l.learner_id, hb.employee_id
  FROM learners l
  JOIN hr_bridge hb ON lower(replace(l.email, '.contractor', '')) = lower(hb.work_email)
),
rep_course_flags AS (
  SELECT lr.employee_id,
    COALESCE(BOOL_OR(c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation'), FALSE) AS completed_advneg,
    COALESCE(BOOL_OR(c.course_name = 'Intro to Spreadsheets'), FALSE) AS completed_distract
  FROM learner_rep lr
  LEFT JOIN course_completions cc ON cc.learner_id = lr.learner_id
  LEFT JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = cc.course_id
  GROUP BY lr.employee_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(CASE WHEN rcf.completed_advneg THEN o.quota_attainment END) * 100
  - AVG(CASE WHEN NOT rcf.completed_advneg THEN o.quota_attainment END) * 100 AS advneg_lift_points
FROM opportunities o
JOIN rep_course_flags rcf ON o.employee_id = rcf.employee_id;
